create_team: create a new team with a unique alias and optional model list using TeamAPI
add_team_member: add a single member to a team with a specified role using TeamAPI
delete_team_member: delete a team member by user ID from a team using TeamAPI
get_team_info: retrieve team information including members and models using TeamAPI
verify_member_in_team: verify if a user exists in a team by checking members_with_roles
